message:
The other day, my granddaughter asked me why we have those go-bags tucked away in the closet. I smiled, remembering the time a storm whipped through and we had to huddle together, flashlight in hand, while the wind howled outside. At that moment, I felt a little smug, thinking, "I told you so!" as I pointed out our ready supplies. Turns out, having a little preparedness goes a long way in making those moments feel less daunting. 

It’s funny how something as simple as a go-bag can offer a sense of calm when the unexpected happens. Have you ever had one of those moments where you were glad you had planned ahead?
